name: Weather, Now
description: Current conditions plus feels-like, humidity, wind, UV and sun times. Data from Open-Meteo (no API key required).

cell_options.name: location
cell_options.label: Location
cell_options.help: Search for a city; the editor stores the matched name + coordinates together. Leave blank to fall back to the manual latitude / longitude / label fields below, or to the server-wide default from Settings → Server → Location.

cell_options.name: latitude
cell_options.label: Latitude (override)
cell_options.help: Optional. Overrides whatever the Location search picked. Decimal degrees.

cell_options.name: label
cell_options.label: Place label (override)
cell_options.help: Optional. Overrides the city name from Location, useful if you want to display 'Home' or similar instead of the city.
